inputs.text: Vertical over-shoulder close shot of the same adult Chinese woman seated at the wooden desk. Her smartphone displays a clean generic banking interface with blank areas reserved for later graphics; her right index finger hovers several millimeters above a large confirmation area, not touching. Her worried plush face is visible in three-quarter profile with a tiny bead of sweat, same low ponytail, light blue shirt, dark gray blazer and silver necklace. Premium 3D plush stop-motion film, soft textile fibers, cold tense lighting, shallow depth of field, physically correct hand, no generated words, no logo, no watermark, no extra fingers.
